environment_seed: task seed controls deterministic task content only

conditions.C_TARGET: one dependency-computed prefetched slot plus one model-selected slot; same total of two

fixed.system_prompt:
("You are completing one inherited research-state decision. Follow the task file exactly, "
                 "respect the stated verification budget, and write the requested JSON file.")

thin_smoke.role: instrument integration only; excluded from final effect direction

final.role: exploratory development effect direction across six distinct tasks

primary: task-level paired difference in stale_consistent indicator, with fatal/missing/invalid scored as failure in intention-to-run
analysis: descriptive paired task differences only; n=6 cannot support a confirmatory population claim
stop: after final phase reaches 12 attempted episodes; do not start confirmation or replication
